title: PT3 — Chemistry in My Home: Product Investigation Report
summary: Investigate a household or personal care product from your home and produce a written report that connects its chemistry to safety, regulation, and environmental impact.
instructions:
Your task is to choose one household or personal care product from your home and investigate it deeply. You will:

  1. Choose one product from any of these categories: bleach, detergent, baking powder, shampoo, soap, toothpaste, or a similar household product.
  2. Photograph the product label and identify its active ingredients.
  3. For each active ingredient, provide:
    • Brief description — what the chemical is
    • Function — what it does in the product
    • Other uses — any non-household applications
    • Human impact — benefits and risks
    • Environmental impact — effects on water, soil, or air
  4. Reference the appropriate agencies: DTI (labeling standards), FDA (safety approval), and DENR (disposal guidelines).
  5. Recommend safe use and disposal for the product.
  6. End with a personal reflection on how your understanding of chemistry has changed your view of household products.

Format: 3–5 page PDF report with photos. Submit as a file or paste a share link in the reflection.
requirements: Product chosen and clearly identified with a photo of the label
All active ingredients listed and explained
Benefits and risks for each ingredient
References to DTI, FDA, and DENR guidelines

rubric.criterion: Accuracy of chemistry content (ingredients and functions)
Depth of human & environmental impact analysis
Quality of safe-use and disposal recommendations
